[SWS_DM_01951] No session checks if no diagnostic session inside the diag-
nostic access permission
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04226
⌈
If the
Diagnostic Server instance
is evaluating the diagnostic session to exe-
cute the current diagnostic service and no
DiagnosticAccessPermission
or
Di-
agnosticAccessPermission.diagnosticSession
references are configured,
the
Diagnostic Service instance
shall directly execute the diagnostic service
and skip the session checks.
⌋
